exports.name: ImageLoadState
exports.description: Image load watcher (Phase 015, internal; research R1, contracts/media-api.md §1). Reports `loading`, `loaded` or `error` for an `` WITHOUT missing a `load` that happened before it was attached: the first report is synchronous from `complete`/`naturalWidth`. `load` waits for `decode()` (rejection tolerated — the state is re-read) so a reveal never shows a half-decoded frame. A MutationObserver on `src`/`srcset`/`sizes` re-evaluates after an explicit source change; answers of an older generation are dropped. Native attributes are never written. A responsive `srcset` candidate swap (viewport/DPR) keeps the current image visible, so it only reports `loaded` again.
